card.title: Nintendo Wii System wont read discs

source.title: Nintendo Wii System wont read discs

claims.statement: Wii laser pot: counter-clockwise lowers resistance and raises laser power; lower it only 50–100 Ω at a time—too low burns out the laser and burns rings into discs.

procedure: Replace spindle or laser motor as needed.
Measure pot, then lower 50–100 Ω; replace laser if no change.
cautions: SOURCE RISK: Lowering the pot too far burns out the laser and damages discs.
card.caveats: Community-written Repair Wiki page, paraphrased; check the linked page (and its images) before acting on a reading.
